newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF says to seek 63,000T of oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF says to seek 63,000T of oilseeds.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation (NLCF) has invited tenders to buy a total of 63,000 tonnes of oilseeds by 11:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Friday, an official with the federation said on Wednesday.

The tenders broke down into 20,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet, 13,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal, 10,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal, 10,000 tonnes of copra and 10,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal, the NLCF official said.
If it passes on the tenders in whole or partially on Friday due to high prices, it will re-invite the tenders on March 11, the NLCF official said.
